events.title: CONTINUUM (TACA Members’ Exhibition)
events.source: Noosa Regional Gallery / The Australian Ceramics Association
events.description: A curated exhibition showcasing contemporary ceramic works from members of The Australian Ceramics Association, highlighting diverse techniques and artistic approaches.

events.title: Sunshine Coast National Art Prize 2026 — Finalists Exhibition
events.source: Caloundra Regional Gallery / Sunshine Coast Council
events.description: The exhibition displays the works of the finalists for the 2026 Sunshine Coast National Art Prize, representing a diverse range of contemporary Australian visual arts.

events.title: Catherine Dinkelmann — Be(longing) (Pop‑up artisan)
events.source: Caloundra Regional Gallery / Caloundra Gallery Store
events.description: A pop-up artisan display featuring ceramic works by Catherine Dinkelmann, exploring themes of belonging and craftsmanship.

events.title: Drawing Room with Laith McGregor (4‑day workshop)
events.location: Cooroy Butter Factory Arts Centre, Cooroy
events.source: Cooroy Butter Factory Arts Centre / pARTicipate Winter School
events.description: An intensive 4-day drawing workshop led by artist Laith McGregor, focused on developing personal creative voice and drawing techniques.

events.title: Butterfly Book with Adele Outterridge (bookbinding workshop)
events.location: Cooroy Butter Factory Arts Centre, Cooroy
events.source: Cooroy Butter Factory Arts Centre / pARTicipate Winter School
events.description: A hands-on workshop led by Adele Outterridge teaching the construction of the 'butterfly book', a unique structural bookbinding technique.

events.title: Psychologically‑Informed Creative Wellbeing Experience
events.location: Cooroy Butter Factory Arts Centre, Cooroy
events.source: Cooroy Butter Factory Arts Centre / Paulette Gee (Bright Spots)
events.description: A 4-week series integrating psychological principles with creative practice to promote personal wellbeing and self-reflection in a group setting.

events.title: Analog Social — Social Games Night (TTT Club)
events.description: A social games night hosted by the TTT Club designed for connecting people through table-top games in an informal, relaxed atmosphere.

events.title: Funny Coast Comedy: Dave Thornton & Friends
events.source: Funny Coast Comedy / The Old Ambulance Station
events.description: An evening of live stand-up comedy featuring Dave Thornton and local supporting acts at the intimate Black Box Theatre.
